character_desc: The dreamer of the group. Inhaler in one hand, treasure map in the other. When the Goonies want to quit, Mikey's speeches keep them going.
actor_facts: He grew up to play Samwise the hobbit in The Lord of the Rings.
His mom, Patty Duke, was a famous actress who won an Oscar as a teenager.
He says fans still yell GOONIES NEVER SAY DIE at him almost every day.

character_desc: Klutzy, hungry, and eventually 100 percent honest. His Truffle Shuffle opens the gate, and his big heart wins over a monster.
actor_facts: He caught chicken pox during filming, and makeup covered the spots so he could keep going.
He grew up to become a real Hollywood lawyer who makes movie deals.
The Truffle Shuffle dance was invented just for this movie.

character_desc: The inventor with booby-trap counter-measures strapped to his chest. Pinchers of Peril! Slick Shoes! Sometimes they even work.
actor_facts: The year before, he was Short Round in Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom.
In 2023 he won an Oscar, almost 40 years after playing Data.
He came to America as a refugee kid from Vietnam before becoming a movie star.

character_desc: The fast talker who never stops joking, translates Spanish (badly, on purpose), and secretly cares about his friends more than he lets on.
actor_facts: He was one of the busiest kid actors of the 1980s: Gremlins, Stand by Me, and more.
He improvised a bunch of Mouth's jokes on set.
He and Sean Astin are still friends and do Goonies reunions together.
